trial_court: High Court of Uttarakhand at Nainital, Criminal Writ Petition no. 155 of 2013
case_name: Jyoti vs State Of Uttarakhand Through Secretary ... on 15 February, 2013

parties.respondent_defendant: State of Uttarakhand through Secretary Home and others

facts_of_case: Petitioners are sisters-in-law of respondent no. 3 Mamta (complainant). Impugned FIR is counter blast to petition filed by brother of petitioners under section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act against his wife.

legal_principles.principle: Abuse of process of law can be inferred if a complaint is filed with malafide intentions.
legal_principles.held: It is pleaded that due to the matrimonial discord between respondent no. 3 and her husband, in the impugned first information report petitioners have been implicated falsely by the complainant which is abuse of process of law.
cited_cases: Jyoti vs State Of Uttarakhand Through Secretary ... on 15 February, 2013

legal_principles.principle: A petition can be quashed if it is filed with malafide intentions.
cited_cases: Jyoti vs State Of Uttarakhand Through Secretary ... on 15 February, 2013

outcome.final_order: Petitioners shall not be arrested in connection with Crime No. 21 of 2012, during investigation provided that they cooperate with the investigating agency.
